instance.finding_key: packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts::yorkiestore bounds ignore `batchoverlay`, so batched writes expand unbounded ranges against stale extents

finding.summary: YorkieStore bounds ignore `batchOverlay`, so batched writes expand unbounded ranges against stale extents
finding.evidence: `getUsedBounds()` and the new `const bounds = this.cellIndex.bounds()` in `buildDependantsMap` read only the committed cell index; the `batchOverlay` branch immediately below iterates overlay cells (`for (const [sref, cell] of this.batchOverlay)`) and expands their formulas with those same committed bounds. Cells written/removed in the overlay (e.g. a paste extending column A far past the old extent, or an overlay deletion at the extent) are not reflected, so dependency edges and the expanded range both miss them and `=SUM(A:A)` computes over the pre-batch extent.

decision.reason: I could not verify this finding because the working directory appears completely inaccessible/empty. Glob for `**/yorkie-store.ts`, `packages/*`, and `**/*` all returned "No files found"; a repo-wide Grep for `batchOverlay`, `buildDependantsMap`, and `getUsedBounds` returned no matches; and a Grep for `.` (any non-empty line) returned nothing. Crucially, direct Reads of files from the authoritative changed-file list (packages/sheets/src/store/cell-index.ts and docs/design/sheets/formula.md) also reported "File does not exist" — so the emptiness is a tooling/checkout problem, not evidence that the described code is absent. A `not-present` refutation would require me to have read yorkie-store.ts and seen different code; I read nothing at all. The finding as described (bounds derived from the committed cell index while the batchOverlay branch expands open-ended ranges like =SUM(A:A) against those stale extents, so overlay writes/deletions are missed in dependency edges and range expansion) is a plausible logic/correctness bug squarely in the Correctness lane, with impact on computed values. Per the rubric, uncertainty for any reason keeps the finding, so I confirm with low confidence rather than dropping it from the merge gate.
